ACADEMIC LEARNING CENTRE

School Curriculum

Teachers and students can view the scheme for a specific class, subject and term. Teachers should save the subjects assigned to their account to receive a focused view.

My Registered Teaching Scheme

Your saved class, term and subject are kept on this device. When connected to the school backend, these values should be linked to the teacher's registered account and permissions.

Select your class, term and subject, then tap “Show My Scheme.”

Learning Materials & Purchase Requests

The curriculum identifies practical materials, stationery and equipment needed for lessons. Prices can be added later by the school administrator.

School Materials Catalogue

View the complete list of school materials, practical equipment, stationery and approved gadgets.

Need an extra item or gadget?

Items already paid for in the school fee form are excluded. Additional stationery, materials or gadgets may be requested through the official sales and marketing service.

Calendar Events

Important calendar notices
  • Schools may select any two days between 7–11 September 2026 for Staff Professional Development (SPD).
  • Open Day is mandatory; timing is at the school's discretion.
  • Public holidays are mandatory and subject to Federal Government announcement.
  • International Literacy Day is 8 September 2026; International Day of Education is 24 January 2027.
  • International-curriculum flexibility applications were due on 21 August 2026.
